title: WMI consumes the staffing figures already carried by the organ bridge
problem: At WMI 7a45d223, evidence with different staffing results receives the same count-based reasons and validation priorities. A reported shortage or arithmetically impossible assignment can retain go. This breaks the intended founder-intent-to-verified-outcome transaction at its domain-consumption seam.
founder_intent_refs: Alfonso's current instruction: Do it. Be collaborative,communicative, and use @install-recursive-founder-intent-collaboration-protocol systems and SOPs
baseline: WMI #44 at 7a45d223b74d6eea3b9ed5bdaeb12a3625b525de; real DALEOBANKS #96 at 664ac98c553759ce754bb684cb248225343edd7e; Kernel integration #196 at a1c6dbcb2d5b4f1647b0f3569dbbbdf0aae558d3. Exact boundary package e7dc0cbc9c9a9491da253deee018d471af5a77df. Existing transport, canonical contracts, legal and human-approval gates remain the owners of their present responsibilities.

alternatives.name: Echo the JSON
alternatives.description: Append received figures to reasons without checking arithmetic or affecting validation.
disadvantages: Impossible assignments and shortages can still retain go.
Echoing certified can launder a claim into apparent evidence.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Only for a clearly labeled raw-data viewer, not this assessment consumer.

alternatives.name: Bounded domain reader
alternatives.description: Read the existing labeled JSON; check internal arithmetic; prioritize original-input validation; only tighten go on shortage, ambiguity or inconsistency.
advantages: No new dependency, shared contract, authority or scoring model.
Makes figure differences observable in reasons and next actions.
disadvantages: Knows only one existing report shape.
Cannot independently verify original demand, feasibility or optimality.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Selected as a reversible draft experiment; retain only if consumer effects and existing gates pass.

alternatives.name: Typed problem-and-witness contract with independent recertification
alternatives.description: Extend the canonical wire with original problem, witness, provenance and verifier references; independently recertify at consumption.
advantages: Strongest competing architecture for verifiable domain conclusions.
Can establish feasibility and optimality relative to supplied original inputs.
disadvantages: Cross-repository contract and trust change requires owner coordination and separate review.
Original inputs and independent provenance are absent from this packet.
alternatives.revival_evidence: A separately owned canonical contract proposal carrying complete original inputs and independently reviewable verification obligations.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Keep figure-blind assessments and rely on a later human to notice staffing deficiencies.
disadvantages: The existing 15-step transport proof still does not prove figure-sensitive domain consumption.

roles.position: Single Codex implementer's explicit self-review perspective; preserve BODY + ORGANS + MIND. This component cannot close the parent machine.
material_concerns: Do not substitute transported bytes for useful consumption.
Resume the full-machine parent after integration.

roles.position: Keep domain interpretation in WMI and canonical authority and contracts in Kernel; use the existing reasons and validation_plan seam.
material_concerns: No schema fork, parallel authority, new transport or dependency pins.
Stronger original-input recertification remains a separate capability deficit.

roles.position: A certified boolean and a signed transport do not prove a staffing result. Attack quantities, ambiguity and authority claims.
material_concerns: Duplicate JSON keys, booleans, nonfinite values, malformed/truncated data, conflicting alternatives and misleading certificates.
A broken recognized report must not silently disappear.

roles.position: Keep the implementation small, bounded, independently revertible and compatible with the pinned real producer.
material_concerns: Do not overwrite the integrator's organ branches or claims.
Fixed-port tests must allow TIME_WAIT while refusing a live listener.

roles.position: Internal consistency is the ceiling of this reader's evidence. A shortage calls for validation, not a claim that the business or people are deficient.
material_concerns: No real demand, buyer acceptance, commercial result or optimality verification is claimed.
Independent review is unassigned and pending; these are five perspectives from one worker.

evidence.finding: Before the source change: 3 failed, 1 passed. Failures are behavioral assertions, not dependency or collection errors.

evidence.claim: The reader causes the measured consumer change.
evidence.finding: Replacing only the reader with an empty reader in a separate process restores all 3 behavioral failures. Production source SHA-256 stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Current WMI tests pass with the pinned real producer.
evidence.finding: 167 passed in 12.66s on Python 3.12.14. Includes actual DALEOBANKS stated_evidence and HTTP client, packaged uvicorn command, signed response checking, startup refusal and restart/replay controls. No route, JWT or evaluation overrides in the producer-consumer test.

evidence.claim: New code adds no lint diagnostics.
evidence.finding: Ruff passed the 3 new Python files. Edited intake has exactly the baseline's 27 inherited diagnostics and no additional diagnostic code/message occurrences.

counterevidence.finding: False: parent completion remains open. Kernel pin adoption, integrated mission assertions, independent review, other machine gaps and real-use evidence remain separate.

counterevidence.claim: Transport or internal arithmetic verifies the original staffing problem or real outcome.
counterevidence.finding: The original certifier requires the original normalized problem. The received packet lacks it. This reader therefore never claims capacity feasibility, optimality, real demand or independent verification.

False: initial full run had 6 executable-path failures (160 passed), fixed by putting the installed venv on PATH. The next run had a TIME_WAIT bind failure (166 passed); the new test now mirrors uvicorn SO_REUSEADDR. Full final run passes.

pass_1.intended_outcome: Reported staffing figures materially affect WMI reasons and validation priorities while no report can create authority or override stronger holds.

advantages.statement: Consume existing evidence without changing its contract.
advantages.amplified_value: Reuse canonical validation and signed transport; preserve ordinary-evidence compatibility.

advantages.statement: Shortfalls cannot hide behind the evidence-count heuristic.
advantages.amplified_value: Check reported totals against assignment and unfilled sums; make unresolved validation the first step.

disadvantages.statement: A plausible forged report can satisfy arithmetic.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Label every result unverified; explicitly request original demand/capacity and independent acceptance; ignore certificates and approval claims.

disadvantages.statement: Brittle text recognition or bounded input can miss or truncate a plan.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Interpret only the existing producer label and whole JSON; recognized truncation remains unresolved; ordinary prose remains compatible; document scope and limits.

disadvantages.statement: A local patch can drift from the live integration owners.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Claim the consumer seam on #96, refresh source heads, use a new child branch and draft PR, and leave integration acknowledgment pending.

comparisons.baseline: Count-based heuristic remains as context; the new reader adds domain reasons and a conservative hold rather than replacing the scorer.
comparisons.do_nothing: Rejected because the three direct consumer assertions fail.
comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: Echoing data is smaller but cannot identify inconsistent totals or prioritize a shortage.
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: Canonical original-problem/witness recertification is stronger but depends on absent inputs and a separately reviewed shared-contract change.
comparisons.reversible_experiment: Selected: isolated WMI reader with existing schema fields, fail-before/pass-after tests, reader-only ablation, real pinned producer check and a draft child PR.

rejected_alternatives.name: New staffing case enum or assessment field
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Would fork the strict canonical assessment contract for a local domain feature.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: Canonical contract owner accepts a use case not expressible in existing reasons/validation_plan.

rejected_alternatives.name: Increase opportunity score for certified reports
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Would reward an unverified self-description and mask evidence quality.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: Independent verified outcomes plus calibrated evidence-quality model and separate review.

pass_2.attack_summary: Attack the strengthened design for data/authority confusion, duplicate keys and noninteger quantities, truncation, conflicting scenarios, ordering, limits, and tautological tests. Verify consumer causality by ablation and the real signed producer path.

new_weaknesses.statement: JSON booleans, duplicate keys, nonfinite numbers and nested approval claims can look valid.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Exact integer checks, duplicate-key and nonfinite-number rejection, bounded complete parsing, human-approval assertions and ignored certificate/instruction text.

new_weaknesses.statement: Different reports may be alternatives rather than contradictions; a clean earlier report can bury an invalid later report.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Ask to distinguish alternatives from contradictions against original inputs; prioritize unresolved reports regardless of wire order.

new_weaknesses.statement: A unit-only demonstration can miss actual packaging, signed transport and producer truncation.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Run the pinned real producer's stated_evidence and HTTP client against Docker COPY/CMD composition; retain existing restart and security controls. Docker image build and integrated Kernel repin remain separate.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: A claim-only wire cannot supply independent truth. Conservative holds and explicit unverified wording prevent false upgrade, but coherent fabrication remains possible.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.owner: WMI maintainer; canonical contract owner for future original-input verification
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Before treating these figures as verified input or allowing action on them.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Current actual label and shape are exercised; malformed recognized reports stay visible. Other report forms are outside this feature.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Producer label/format changes or a real mission needs a different evidence type.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: A separate branch stacks on the unchanged #44 head; the shared consumer claim was rechecked and no conflicting claim was observed. Review and receiver acknowledgment remain pending.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Before publication, any owner update, and handoff intake.

pass_2.final_design: A bounded domain reader feeds the existing assessment reasons and validation_plan. It can only change go to needs_more_evidence, never promote another verdict. Existing legal and human-approval floors remain. This is ordinary domain integration, not a novel cognition or commercial-performance claim.
